jobs.description: Overview Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity. With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. Business Segment Overview Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. Responsibilities Position Purpose: The Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for the administration, performance, availability, security, and automation of StoneX’s database platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. The role focuses on ensuring highly available, secure, and performant database services while leveraging automation, AI-driven tools, and modern operational practices to improve efficiency and reliability. The DBA will support Microsoft SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server environments, while developing broader expertise across MongoDB, cloud-native database services, and modern database automation practices. Primary duties will include: Database Operations & Support Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server environments across production and non-production systems. Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and provide support for critical incidents across SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server platforms. Ensure database availability, stability, and performance in line with business SLAs. Perform database installations, upgrades, patching, migrations, and configuration management for SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Manage and maintain high availability and disaster recovery solutions, including SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server replication, backup/restore, and cloud-native HA options. Performance Monitoring & Optimisation Monitor SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server performance using enterprise monitoring, observability, and platform-native tooling. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across database engines. Conduct database tuning activities including query optimisation, indexing strategies, statistics maintenance, configuration improvements, and workload analysis. Develop and maintain health checks, monitoring standards, and performance baselines for SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server estates. Perform root cause analysis for database incidents and provide recommendations for long-term platform improvements. Backup, Recovery & Data Protection Manage backup and recovery solutions using Cohesity, Delphix, Azure-native tooling, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server backup patterns, and SQL Server technologies. Ensure recovery procedures align with defined RPO and RTO requirements across SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server workloads. Regularly test backup, restore, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery processes. Support data protection, masking, refresh, retention, and recovery practices for production and non-production database environments. Cloud & Platform Services Support database workloads hosted in Microsoft Azure. Manage Azure SQL services, Azure Database for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Flexible Server, and related cloud database technologies. Assist with cloud migrations, platform modernisation initiatives, and cost optimisation efforts. Support Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server cloud operational patterns including monitoring, backup, high availability, security configuration, patching, and migration readiness. Utilise AI and automation capabilities to improve cloud operations and monitoring. Automation & AI Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, T-SQL, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server tooling, and APIs. Implement Infrastructure as Code and automation frameworks where appropriate. Leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GPTs, and monitoring analytics to accelerate troubleshooting and operational efficiency. Build automated monitoring, alerting, remediation, health check, and reporting solutions for SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server platforms. Promote responsible AI usage while maintaining accountability for technical decisions. Governance, Security & Compliance Ensure database platforms comply with security standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies. Support audit, vulnerability remediation, access review, encryption, and security improvement initiatives. Identify operational risks and implement appropriate controls across SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server environments. Contribute to database standards, documentation, operational runbooks, and best practices. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Work closely with application teams, infrastructure teams, architects, and business stakeholders. Support Agile delivery processes and project initiatives. Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, mentoring, and cross-skilling between SQL Server and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server disciplines. Continuously evaluate emerging database technologies, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server ecosystem capabilities, and operational improvements. Qualifications To land this role you will need : 2–5 years of Database Administration experience. Strong Microsoft SQL Server administration skills (SQL Server 2016+). Working knowledge or hands-on experience with Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server administration, with a strong willingness to develop deeper Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server expertise. Experience with performance tuning and optimisation across relational database platforms. Experience with backup and recovery strategies, including point-in-time recovery concepts. Experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, clustering technologies, and/or Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server high availability and replication concepts. T-SQL development and troubleshooting; exposure to Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server SQL, PL/pgSQL, psql, pgAdmin, or similar tooling is desirable. Database monitoring, observability, health checks, and operational reporting. Azure database services and cloud platforms, including Azure SQL and Azure Database for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server Flexible Server. Experience supporting business-critical systems in a 24x7 environment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. What makes you stand out: Experience with Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server, MongoDB or other open-source databases. Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server administration skills including backup/restore, replication, extensions, security, monitoring, performance tuning, and version upgrades. Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages. Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub, Terraform, Liquibase, Ansible, or Azure DevOps. Experience with Delphix, Cohesity, Redgate, SolarWinds, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or similar enterprise tools. Knowledge of financial services environments and regulatory requirements. Microsoft Azure certifications, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server certifications, or relevant database certifications. Competencies: Accountability and ownership. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Continuous learning mindset. Collaboration and teamwork. Customer-focused approach. Adaptability and innovation. Commitment to automation and operational excellence. Working environment: Hybrid (4 days’ work from office). Participation in an on-call support rotation. Occasional out-of-hours work during maintenance activities or critical incidents. Occasional travel as required. The role requires availability to work from a start time between 5AM and 7AM IST.

jobs.description: 工作职责： 采购执行与供应商管理 负责工厂直接采购：包括生产运营化学品原料、包装材料、外加工产品的采购全流程（寻源、询比价、谈判、合同签订）。 开发并维护优质稳定的供应商资源，协同跨部门定期评估供应商绩效，确保供应商资源不断优化提升。 必要时管理外加工产品的供应链协同，确保加工质量与交付周期符合生产计划。 成本节约策略制定与执行 基于市场行情，制定并实施年度/季度成本节约目标和计划。 通过谈判、招标、替代方案分析、本地化开发等手段，实现可持续的成本优化。 定期输出采购成本分析报告，提出策略调整建议。 流程与系统管理 负责SAP采购模块的日常运行，包括采购价格维护、合同管理等。 推动采购流程标准化与合规化，确保符合全球总部及公司内控与审计要求。 主导并管理部门采购数据分析、KPI监控（如成本节约率等）。 跨部门协作 与生产计划、运营、物流、质量、研发、财务等部门紧密合作，确保采购物料的及时性并满足技术规范、安全与环保标准。 支持新品开发或变更管理中的采购需求，提供物料选型与成本建议。 风险管理与合规 识别并管理供应风险（单一来源、价格波动、物流中断等），制定应急预案并予以执行落实。 确保采购活动符合公司政策、行业法规及国际贸易条款。 任职要求： 学历：本科及以上，化工、材料、供应链管理、国际贸易等相关专业优先。 工作经验：5-8年采购专业相关经验，其中至少3年以上大型制造企业（化工/材料/医药行业优先）直接采购岗位经验，担任过采购专员或以上采购职位。 具备一定的采购团队管理经验（或项目带教经验）或团队管理潜力，能够独立分配任务、跟进执行并进行绩效反馈。
